name: copy-that
description: Copy That: taste-first skills for people who make and ship things. Launch films, launch plans, Chinese copy, share images, and skills that actually work.

plugins.name: pro-motion
plugins.description: Audio-first MG films in code (canvas → MP4): pick an unconventional campaign mechanism (12 stunt levers), plan the music as a marketing asset (sonic logo, hooks, Suno/Udio prompts, post-production), then beat analysis, reference contact sheets, style frames, protagonist shot maps, motion library with 40+ AE / Blender-style effects, parallel rendering, multi-language cuts.

plugins.name: pro-launch
plugins.description: Product lifecycle skill: positioning, naming and domains, reference hunting, style bible and style frames, feature map, UI build loop, asset generation, device QA, launch video, GTM, growth and open-source/App Store shipping.

plugins.name: renhua
plugins.description: Chinese writing in a real person's voice: strips AI tells (emoji lists, slogans, 不是而是), fluent full sentences, theme line, results first, data-backed insight and one earned 金句; viral Xiaohongshu title library and optional humor patterns.

plugins.name: post
plugins.description: Share-image sets for Xiaohongshu and X: App Store poster layout, real screenshots, faithful app-UI mocks, charts that aren't tables, a series/IP layer for go-to-market, fluent copy.

plugins.name: skill-skill
plugins.description: Distil real work into skills with forcing functions (artifacts, gates, scripts), triggerable descriptions, a spec-based audit with health score and badge, and one-command reports for public skill repos.
